author: Russell Brand
description:
Russell shares the story of a Satanic church leader who stepped into a pitch dark ritual room to summon a demon and check whether the Antichrist had already been born, only for the room to fill with an unexplainable light and a presence he could only describe as pure love. The man says he instantly recognized the figure standing before him and walked out of that room a completely changed person, leaving Satanism behind for good. It is one of those stories that sounds impossible until you hear him describe it in his own words, and it might make you rethink what is really out there in the spiritual realm. This is the kind of encounter you do not walk away from unchanged.

author: Russell Brand
description:
Russell breaks down two studies covering 8.7 million people that found the vaccinated group developed significantly higher rates of seven major cancers compared to the unvaccinated, and points to the CDC's own WONDER database showing excess cancer deaths climbing right after the mass vaccination campaign began. He raises an uncomfortable question about the financial ties between the industry that produced the shots and the industry that profits from treating the cancers that may follow, arguing that when scientists are invested in an outcome, the lying often takes care of itself. It is a deep dive into the numbers the government has already published, and what they might mean when you actually connect the dots. A conversation that demands you look closely at who benefits and how.
